entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The morning sunlight streamed throu..."
entries.dialogueText: The morning sunlight streamed through the windows as Lucian and I entered the White Room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She poured me a cup with a smile, t..."
entries.dialogueText: She poured me a cup with a smile, then took a look down at the folder in front of me.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""It looks like you have quite the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "It looks like you have quite the packed agenda for today, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""I'm sorry again about the disturba..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry again about the disturbance my indiscretion caused. I hope it didn't create too much extra work for you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian's madcap accusations create..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian's madcap accusations created the disturbance, not you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It wasn't your fault. It was my le..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't your fault. It was my lecher of a vice president."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I do expect more professional beha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do expect more professional behavior from you going forward, Ms. Suno."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My work is none of your business.""
entries.dialogueText: "My work is none of your business."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""You're absolutely right. My apolog..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're absolutely right. My apologies, Mr. President. Enjoy your coffee."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""And you will get it, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you will get it, Mr. President. Enjoy your coffee."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Don't be too hard on Petr. I was a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be too hard on Petr. I was as reckless as he was."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""He did seem to be trying to protec..."
entries.dialogueText: "He did seem to be trying to protect you, in his own way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked over and poured myself a c..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked over and poured myself a cup. I wondered when my new secretary would start work.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She walked out. I enjoyed a split s..."
entries.dialogueText: She walked out. I enjoyed a split second of solitude before the morning's first meeting.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But I did want to give you a quick..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I did want to give you a quick word of warning."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have noticed that the USP factio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have noticed that the USP faction in the Assembly has adopted a confrontational stance of late."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Their displeasure with you has led..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their displeasure with you has led them to engage in obstructionist tactics, slowing down policy implementation and creating legislative gridlock."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So... what does that actually mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "So... what does that actually mean?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Damn. I really have turned into th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Damn. I really have turned into the next Alphonso, haven't I?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll show them what happens when y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll show them what happens when you get in the way of Anton Rayne."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Blocking progress for the country..."
entries.dialogueText: "Blocking progress for the country because of their petty disagreements with me. I hope they're happy with themselves."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It means we will have a significan..."
entries.dialogueText: "It means we will have a significantly harder time following through with our plans for this portion of the term, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It won't be easy to get past this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "It won't be easy to get past this, I'm afraid.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The Assembly did employ similar ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Assembly did employ similar tactics to block your predecessor's reforms, yes."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It is my hope that we're still abl..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is my hope that we're still able to follow through on some of our plans for this term. But it won't be easy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He dropped a thick folder in front..."
entries.dialogueText: He dropped a thick folder in front of me.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I was hoping to go over the day's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was hoping to go over the day's agenda with you before your cabinet members began arriving. But duty calls."

entries.dialogueText: He walked out. Almost immediately, as if she'd been waiting for him to leave, Livia entered with a carafe of coffee,
